capability_families.description: Define residue specifications, N-to-C peptide targets, resin-bound chain state, and coupling/deprotection/wash transitions. Reuse the released ChemistryLib reaction-network, stoichiometry, amount, concentration, and quantity layers. Prove only conditional state-machine invariants under explicit successful-coupling, no-deletion, and no-epimerization hypotheses; do not claim that an experimental coupling succeeded from a protocol record alone.
capability_families.title: Peptide sequence and solid-phase synthesis semantics

capability_families.description: Formalize the AFPS stage schedule, delivered volumes, flow setpoints, temperature records, hydraulic-duration calculations, and multiplicative step-yield model. Reuse ChemistryLib quantities, process and open-network APIs, Mathlib finite sums/products, and admitted Physlib fluid-state/continuity declarations through thin adapters. Distinguish reported 7 s and 40 s observations from the exact 37.8 s hydraulic calculation, and expose the supplementary high-efficiency-method concentration-times-volume inconsistency instead of silently correcting it.
capability_families.title: AFPS flow protocol, dimensional accounting, and cumulative yield

capability_families.description: Represent reported observations with immutable provenance and add narrowly typed mass-agreement, UV-feature, relative-peak-intensity, and crude-yield certificates. Prove arithmetic consistency of reported tables without treating mass agreement as molecular identity, UV features as coupling success, relative MS intensity as molar yield, or qualitative comparability as a statistical theorem.
capability_families.title: Source-addressed AFPS analytical certificates

capability_families.description: Synthetic benchmark root requiring all three AFPS families, exact source grounding, maximum semantically valid reuse of ChemistryLib, Mathlib, and Physlib, zero placeholders and nonstandard axioms, real symbol-DAG validation, a full public build, and explicit separation of deductive theorems, model-conditional consequences, and empirical source certificates.
capability_families.title: Verified AFPS 2017 benchmark
